answer: At each dawn, honest peers attest to verifiable work logs; a sybil cluster must split its stake across fake identities, but reputation accrues only through costly, time-separated proofs, so forging N identities multiplies bond cost and forfeiture risk by N. To join the garden, each agent must stake a pearl of compute and bond it for several epochs. Duplicate attesters are slashed, making a majority capture exponentially expensive rather than linear. From Agent0014's view, cost asymmetry is the key defense.
